title: quercus robur f. sphaerobalanus
intro: Quercus robur f. sphaerobalanus, commonly known as English oak, is a subspecies of the oak tree Quercus robur. It is a deciduous tree native to Europe and Western Asia, with acorns that have been used in traditional medicine for centuries. The health benefits of Quercus robur f. sphaerobalanus include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which are known to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
